You agree to use them only in a safe and lawful way, and you accept full responsibility for doing so. Do not watch video, read, or interact with any screen while the vehicle is in motion. The driver’s attention belongs on the road.

Beebo Auto plays your library's audio through the car speakers and does not put video on the car's screen. If you separately use any other third-party project that puts video on a car screen, the same obligations above apply in full: you must not rely on any built-in safety feature to make it safe or legal to use a screen while driving, and any such feature is a safety aid, not a guarantee — sensors, cars, and software can be wrong, delayed, or unavailable.
